mechanism_name: release-sign spillover continuation drift on non-reporting pairs (GB+CA bloc)
causal_claim_one_sentence: Because trade invoicing is dominated by the USD leg (Gopinath dominant-currency pricing), importers, exporters and liquidity providers carrying non-reporting currency books are forced to rebalance USD exposure when a GB or CA CPI print reprices global USD rate expectations, and their staggered rebalancing leaves a same-sign drift on the non-reporting pairs for several days after the print-window reaction; the mechanism must fail if the spillover reaction is fully arbitraged inside the 24-hour reaction window or if dealer inventory absorbs the flow before the first 16:00-NY funded decision.
falsification_rule: The claim is proven wrong if any of: (a) sign(r_W)-conditioned positions on non-reporting pairs show nonpositive financing-adjusted expectancy at stress tier 2.0 (rule 1); (b) PF < 1.10 (rule 2) or populated positive folds < 2 of 3 (rule 3); (c) the sham-calendar placebo arm reproduces the anchor's expectancy sign and magnitude within the rule-10 control-coherence bound (mechanism carries no calendar information, contra V6's sham-NEGATIVE precedent on the own-economy form); (d) pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY forbidden exposure schedule measured at D2, especially V6 FXFV6-A4-P1 own-economy reaction-direction drift.
control_class: sham-calendar placebo (mandatory on lane 1): every qualifying (economy, event_date) is shifted +7 calendar days to the SAME WEEKDAY; the shifted clock inherits the identical reaction-window length, funded-decision offset and k-hold semantics; r_W and hold returns are recomputed from the SAME staged price bytes at the shifted dates; a shifted clock is dropped fail-closed if its window overlaps a true same-economy event date or the 2 calendar days bracketing one; V6's sham-NEGATIVE (-910.40, PF 0.899 on the own-pair form) is the recorded proof this control discriminates.
expected_failure_mode: The family is willing to lose to cost domination and USD-leg crowding: at tier 2.0 the round trip costs 6.0 bps against a same-sign drift edge plausibly of similar magnitude; the six non-reporting positions funded by one event date are correlated through the common USD leg, so rule-4 pair concentration (<=0.40) and rule-9 USD-drift diagnostic may kill an otherwise-positive mechanism; fold 1 carries only 84 GB+CA clocks (earliest funding 2020-02-19 because 1h snapshot coverage starts 2020-01-29/30), so rule-3 fold population is a live risk; and PIT exposure is limited to calendar stamps plus provider bars, so an availability-lag mutation that delays event_available_time_utc by +1 day must move each decision exactly one 16:00-NY period or the proposal dies at I/Q.

anchor.spec: for each funded clock, position = sign(r_W) on the non-reporting pair, entered at the funded 16:00-NY instant, held k=4 trading days

neighbour.spec: SAME mechanism, SAME feature, SAME clocks; hold k=9 trading days instead of k=4 (tests whether the spillover drift persists beyond one week; distinct parameter, not a distinct mechanism)
neighbour.note: deliberately NOT the V6 k=5/k=10 grid — the hold axis is shifted so this proposal is not a relabelled parameter twin of the dead own-economy ancestor

control.spec: sham-calendar placebo at anchor parameters (k=4): +7 calendar-day matched-weekday shift of every qualifying event date, identical windows/offsets/holds, recomputed on the same staged price bytes, fail-closed dedupe vs true event dates
control.expected_sign: must NOT reproduce the anchor (rule 10); V6's sham-NEGATIVE shows the control class discriminates when the mechanism carries genuine calendar information

costs: P3 freeze inherited verbatim: 1.5 bps/side x {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}; tier 2.0 PRIMARY; break-even bps gate vs 1.5 floor (rule 5)

folds.rule: 3 folds = thirds of S0 2018-04-04..2025-07-24 by decision_date; calendar-third boundaries 2020-09-09 and 2023-02-16; gate: >=2 of 3 folds positive-populated (rule 3)
folds.non_vacuity: every arm (anchor, neighbour, control) evaluates the same 833 funded clocks by construction, so decisions per fold per arm are 84/378/371 before any cost or gate application — strictly positive in all three folds; the control arm can only shrink by explicit fail-closed dedupe, counted at execution
folds.honest_total: 833 decision evaluations per arm, 2496 across the three arms, each evaluation at most one k-day position; no PnL is computed at D1

gates_referenced: p3_invariants_freeze_v7.json baseline_invariants.rule_order 1-10 verbatim (expectancy mechanical reject at tier 2.0; PF>=1.10; folds>=2/3; pair concentration<=0.40; break-even<=1.5bps floor; dual-book sign non-inversion; LOPO all subsets; tier-2.0 stress margin; USD-drift diagnostic; mechanism sanity with MANDATORY sham-calendar), plus ancestry veto |rho|<=0.20 pooled vs all forbidden inventory including V6 FXFV6-A4-P1 and FXFV6-A6-P2

ancestry_distinctness.vs_V6_FXFV6-A4-P1: that ancestor conditioned REPORTING-economy own pairs (GBPUSD around GB prints, USDCAD-class around CA prints); this proposal NEVER holds the reporting pair — the traded set is exactly the 6 non-reporting pairs per clock, verified absent own-pair leakage in the P2 clocks; the exposure schedules share no (pair, event) cell by construction, and D2 measures pooled |rho|<=0.20 as the binding authority
ancestry_distinctness.vs_V5_avoidance_sham: not a position-avoidance form — positions are OPENED after the window closes, not avoided during it
ancestry_distinctness.vs_V4_V3R_carry: no carry signal, no rate differential anywhere in the conditioning
ancestry_distinctness.vs_V1_V2: no session-of-day momentum/fade structure; the only timing is the frozen 16:00-NY funded decision
